UEXT0002.author: ClinLine
UEXT0002.description: An extension attribute should have exactly one value attribute specified or include nested extension attributes not both.
UEXT0002.conditions:
**@$pt.$distinct(
    [$pt.extensionAttributes@$ea.
    $ea.{"id": id,
         "instanceType": instanceType,
         "path": _path,
         "extensionAttributes": extensionAttributes ? "Defined",
         "valueExtensionClass": valueExtensionClass ? "Defined",
         "valueId": valueId,
         "valueBoolean": valueBoolean,
         "valueCode": valueCode.id ? valueCode.decode,
         "valueString": valueString,
         "valueRange": valueRange.id ? (($exists(valueRange.minValue.value) ? valueRange.minValue.value & " - ") & valueRange.maxValue.value),
         "valueQuantity": valueQuantity,
         "valueInteger": valueInteger,
         "specifiedItems": (extensionAttributes ? 1:0)+(valueExtensionClass ? 1:0)+(valueId?1:0)+(valueBoolean != null ? 1:0)+(valueCode?1:0)+(valueString?1:0)+(valueRange?1:0)+(valueQuantity?1:0)+(valueInteger?1:0)}]
         [specifiedItems != 1])

params.message: Either more than 1 extension attribute type or class is specified and/or none are specified.

UEXT0003.author: ClinLine
UEXT0003.description: The structure within a specified extension identified by a distinct url must be logically consistent throughout the data model e.g. a url in combination with the value type or nested extensions should be unique.
UEXT0003.conditions:
**@$sd
    .
    $filter($sd.extensionAttributes.
        {"id": id, 
        "url": url, 
        "instanceType": instanceType,
        "_path": _path,
        "Defined": extensionAttributes ? "Attributes"  : valueExtensionClass ? "Class" :
                    valueId ? "Id" : valueBoolean ? "Boolean" : 
                    valueCode ? "Code" : valueString ? "String" : 
                    valueRange ? "Range": valueQuantity ? "Quantity" : 
                    valueInteger ? "Integer"}
    ,function($v,$i,$a)
      {
        $count($a[url=$v.url and Defined!=$v.Defined])>0
      })

params.message: The combination of the url with a specified value type is not unique.

UEXT0004.author: ClinLine
UEXT0004.description: If specified, an extension valueCode value must contain an code value in USDM code complex datatype format.
UEXT0004.conditions:
**@$pt.$distinct(
    [$pt.extensionAttributes@$ea.
    $ea.{"id": id,
         "instanceType": instanceType,
         "valueCode": valueCode? true,
         "missingAttribute": 
             $exists(valueCode.id)=false or $exists(valueCode.code)=false or $exists(valueCode.decode)=false or 
             $exists(valueCode.codeSystem)=false or $exists(valueCode.codeSystemVersion)=false or valueCode.instanceType != "Code",
         "path": _path}][valueCode and missingAttribute=true])

params.message: The combination of the url with a specified value type is not unique.
